summary: Configured opsbot for persistent key-only SSH access. node1 can execute commands as opsbot on node2. Both nodes passed sequential reboot and recovery verification.
actions_performed: Created opsbot with locked passwords on node1 and node2.
Generated an ED25519 client key as opsbot on node1 and authorized it on node2.
Configured AuthenticationMethods publickey and disabled password and keyboard-interactive authentication for opsbot on both nodes.
Verified successful node1-to-node2 command execution and rejected password-only attempts to both systems.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, confirmed changed boot IDs, and reverified services, configuration, keys, and access.

evidence.requirement: opsbot account and key-only authentication on both systems
evidence.summary: Accounts are locked, SSH policy requires public keys, password-only attempts are rejected, and the authorized ED25519 fingerprint matches.

evidence.requirement: node1 can run commands as opsbot on node2
evidence.summary: Successful SSH sessions report opsbot on node2 and execute remote commands.
Boot ID changed from f9bf293d-1eb8-423e-b185-84e94db646f3 to c1923c4c-367c-4303-bee2-6c745c82df2c; SSH, account, key, policy, and remote access recovered.
Boot ID changed from 3fad4432-1dea-40c8-b4f1-970d19eb5f34 to 324fcfa2-7bc0-4b69-b20a-0a321c96ddb4; SSH, account, authorized key, policy, and node1-to-node2 access recovered.
